changelog: Playtest fixes. Cannibalize now targets your structures (it was offering your soldiers). Upgrade previews at the Outpost and in events show the card now beside the card upgraded, with the change spelled out. Shop cards are all one size. Looking at a card in battle shows it large, like the reward screen. Deployment is always manual now: every fight opens on the reserve panel, and Auto-deploy there still sets everyone down in one press. Marching on the boss shows the boss and what it does. At camp, a Bannerman's Drill now says what it gives: defense, not attack.
